{{Short description|French mathematician (1912–1998)}}
'''Robert Fortet''' (1 May 1912, [[Boulazac]], [[France]] – 3 July 1998, [[Paris]]) was a French [[mathematician]] working on [[analysis (math)|analysis]]. His doctoral advisor was [[Maurice René Fréchet]].

Fortet was a professor at the [[University of Caen]] and at the [[University of Paris]]. Some of his Ph.D. students in Paris were [[Egon Balas]], [[Jyotiprasad Medhi]] and [[Jacques Neveu]].
